DOP: cavana n. [ cf S. cyavana; AMg cavaṇa], falling; falling away from, abandoning; falling from one state of existence (to another); dying; ceasing ; Abh 404 (maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā … ~aṃ); Dhātup 35 (cu ~e); Ja V 7, 13* (viddhaṃsanaṃ ~aṃ jīvitassa; 7, 25´ : ~an ti cutiṃ); Vism 460, 13 (taṃ tato °-ttā cutī ti vuccati); Sp 584, 24 (kupito ti kuppabhāvaṃ pakatito ~-bhāvaṃ patto); — °- tā , f., abstr. , the state of falling from one existence; death ; M I 49, 24 (tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti ~ā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā) = S II 3, 1 = Nidd I 123, 30 = Paṭis I 38, 2 ; — °- dhamma , mfn. and m. [cavana + dhamma 1 ], 1. ( mfn. ) liable to fall from one existence (to another); liable or about to die ; D I 20, 6 (mayaṃ tamhā kāyā cutā aniccā addhuvā appāyukā ~ā itthattaṃ āgatā ti); M I 326, 28 (~aṃ yeva samānaṃ acavanadhamman ti vakkhati); It 76, 14 (yadā … devo devakāyā ~o hoti pañca pubbanimittāni pātubhavanti; It-a II 76, 1 : ~o ti maraṇadhammo, āyukkhayena vā puññakkhayena vā upaṭṭhitamaraṇo ti attho); Ja VI 482, 8 (sā attano ~-taṃ ajānantī); Mil 129, 16 (idha mahārāja kulaṃ hoti aputtakaṃ … devaputto ca ussannakusalamūlo ~o hoti); Cp-a 77, 3 (~ānaṃ saṭṭhi-sahassānaṃ devaputtānaṃ); — acavanadhamma, mfn. , not liable to die; not liable to fall away from or abandon ; M I 326, 10 (idaṃ niccaṃ idaṃ dhuvaṃ … idaṃ acavanadhammaṃ) = S I 142, 26 ; Ud-a 278, 28 (koci acavanadhammo nāma n’ atthī ti dasseti); 393, 14 (acavanadhammaṃ anirodhaṃ amatan ti attho); It-a II 127, 11 (pātimokkhasīlato acavanadhammatāparidīpanaṃ) = Ud-a 223, 21; Th-a I 18, 12 (acavanadhammattā); — 2. ( m. ) the liability to die, the imminence of death ; Ja V 411, 14 (Kosiyassa taṃ khaṇaṃ yeva ~o jāto, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se nassanadhammo); — acavana , mfn. , not dying; not ceasing ; Nidd-a I 251, 7 (sassato ti ~o).
